_note: Central, configurable definition of automatic ORDER-LEVEL discounts (task spec §5). The database/config is the single source of truth — the rule is NEVER hardcoded across components. Amounts are in AED and compared against the eligible order subtotal (sum of final, VAT-inclusive line totals). The threshold comparison is STRICTLY GREATER THAN (spec §5): 100.00 gets NO discount, 100.01 gets the discount.

rules.name: Order value over AED 100
rules.description: 15% off automatically when the eligible order subtotal is over AED 100.
